member.name: T:Stratum.ModSync
member.summary: Messages between players in the same online room who have this mod installed and enabled.

remarks.para: Delivery goes through the game's multiplayer server and usually takes 0.5–5 seconds. It suits events and shared state (a setting, a score, a ready flag), not data that changes every frame.

Messages queued within one send window (0.5 s) are delivered together; each window may carry up to . If a receiver misses a window (for example, it just joined), those messages are lost: resend important state periodically or when fires.
Only players with the same mod id receive the messages. Other players see nothing.
